vision_source: corner/VISION.md §Pillar 3: Scoped project chats + §How it works today
summary: Live-thread step emission works end-to-end with R65 breathing-dot animations. Self-healing subscriptions with exponential backoff handle network errors. Shared room three-tier permissions fully implemented. Task creation in-scope passes text to endpoint. Cross-room message isolation via RLS + client_id prevents tenant bleed. Top 3 gaps: owner EA routing logic not verifiable from frontend, room cleanup on navigation is implicit (no explicit purge), voice call does not persist across full-app navigation.

commitments.description: Live-thread step emission with R65 breathing-dot design
commitments.evidence: StepThread.jsx 1–188: CSS keyframes (r65StepBreathe, r65StepFade, r65PulseTravel), StepDot renders breathing 8px active dot with glow, ConnectorRow pulses between steps, ThreadStepIndicator colors by status, settlement dimming 0.45 when message text lands.

useChatMessages.js: scheduleReconnect() implements Math.min(30000, 1000 * 2^attempt) backoff. Subscribe effects handle CHANNEL_ERROR/TIMED_OUT/CLOSED with auto-reconnect. handleUpdate() merges incoming rows. Window focus + visibilitychange trigger refetch.

SharedRoomSettings.jsx: Roles defined at lines 6, 59, 88. handleInvite() posts role parameter. handleRoleChange() updates role with confirmation modal. Members list renders with ↓ demote / ↑ promote / ✕ remove buttons, gated by isOwner. Read-only members see list but cannot change roles.

commitments.description: Task creation in-scope (directly from project chat input)
commitments.evidence: ProjectInputBar.jsx: handleCreateTask() takes input text, hits /api/dashboard/create-project-task with project slug. Create Task button rendered, disabled when input empty or project unselected. Inline comment R21c.

commitments.description: Cross-room message isolation via RLS + client_id filtering
commitments.evidence: useChatMessages.js: Agent thread handleInsert() drops if client_id !== worldId (line 150–152). Project thread validates projCid and drops on mismatch (316–319). Shared rooms use shared:<slug>, personal worlds use worldId. No message bleed between tenants.

commitments.description: Owner's EA reply routing to shared rooms
commitments.evidence: ChatPanel.jsx:356 sets shared:${slug} client_id when isShared. useChatMessages.js:274, 291 confirm subscription uses routing. Frontend does not show explicit owner resolution; server-side RLS inference only.
commitments.gap: Owner identity / EA selection logic lives server-side, not verifiable from frontend code.

commitments.evidence: ProjectChatView.jsx:31–117 is controlled shell that mounts/unmounts. Cleanup via React lifecycle on unmount implicit; no explicit purge logic visible for stale step chains or orphaned attachment states.
commitments.gap: Implicit cleanup via unmount; no explicit purge strategy documented.

commitments.description: Live voice call floating bar persisting across full-app navigation
commitments.evidence: ProjectChatView.jsx:80–82 conditionally render ProjectVoiceChatHost and ProjectVoiceModeBar. These unmount when user navigates away from project chat. No floating bar spanning navigation visible.
commitments.gap: Voice call state unmounts when leaving ProjectChatView; does not persist to other surfaces.

top_gaps.commitment: Owner's EA reply routing to shared rooms
top_gaps.issue: Frontend owner resolution logic not visible; server-side RLS inference only
Cleanup is implicit via component unmount; no explicit cross-room message purge logic

top_gaps.commitment: Live voice call floating bar persisting across full-app navigation
top_gaps.issue: Voice call ends when user navigates away from ProjectChatView; no floating bar implementation found

acceptance_gate.notes: 5 core commitments fully built. 3 commitments partial but functional. Known limitations on voice persistence and owner resolution transparency. Core chat, permissions, task creation, and isolation working as designed.
